<script id="atc-blindagem-mobile-js">
(function(){
  function empilha(){
    try{
      var raiz = document.querySelector('.elementor-location-single');
      if (!raiz) { return; }
      var estreito = (window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth) <= 767;
      var cons = raiz.querySelectorAll('.e-con, .e-con-inner');
      for (var i = 0; i < cons.length; i++) {
        var s = cons[i].style;
        if (estreito) {
          s.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          s.setProperty('flex-wrap', 'wrap', 'important');
          s.setProperty('grid-template-columns', '1fr', 'important');
        } else {
          // some o aparelho ficou largo (giro de tela): devolve ao CSS
          s.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          s.removeProperty('flex-wrap');
          s.removeProperty('grid-template-columns');
        }
      }
      var ws = raiz.querySelectorAll('.e-con > .elementor-element, .e-con-inner > .elementor-element');
      for (var j = 0; j < ws.length; j++) {
        var t = ws[j].style;
        if (estreito) {
          t.setProperty('max-width', '100%', 'important');
        } else {
          t.removeProperty('max-width');
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  empilha();
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', empilha);
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', empilha);
  window.addEventListener('resize', empilha);
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', empilha);
  setTimeout(empilha, 1200);
  setTimeout(empilha, 4000);
})();
</script>

.atcr-faixa>div{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:30px 24px 34px}

.atcr-trilha a{color:#fff!important;text-decoration:none!important}
.atcr-faixa h1{font:800 34px/1.15 Montserrat,sans-serif;color:#fff;margin:0}
.atcr-corpo{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 24px 48px}
.atcr-rodape{background:#122F2D;color:#CFEAE7;font:400 14px/1.5 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}
.atcr-rodape>div{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:30px 24px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px 32px;align-items:center}
.atcr-rodape img{height:38px;width:auto;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
.atcr-rodape a{color:#fff!important}
.atcr-rodape ul{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 20px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.atcr-rodape li{margin:0;padding:0}.atcr-rodape li::before{display:none}
@media(max-width:700px){.atcr-faixa h1{font-size:26px}.atcr-marca img{height:32px}.atcr-marca span{font-size:15px}.atcr-topo{position:static}}
@media print{.atcr-topo,.atcr-rodape{display:none}}
</style><header class="atcr-topo"><div><a class="atcr-marca" href="https://radardatransparencia.atricon.org.br/" aria-label="Radar da Transparência, início"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.atricon.org.br/2026/11/pntp-5anos-reduzida-positiva.png" alt="PNTP 5 anos" width="160" height="40"><span>Radar da Transparência<small>Programa Nacional de Transparência Pública</small></span></a><nav aria-label="Navegação do Radar"><ul class="atcr-menu"><li><a href="https://pntp.atricon.org.br/o-programa/">O Programa</a></li><li><a href="https://pntp.atricon.org.br/dados-abertos/">Dados abertos</a></li><li><a href="https://pntp.atricon.org.br/">Site do PNTP</a></li><li><a class="forte" href="https://radardatransparencia.atricon.org.br/painel-6/">Consultar uma entidade</a></li></ul></nav></div></header><div class="atcr-faixa"><div><p class="atcr-trilha"><a href="https://radardatransparencia.atricon.org.br/">Radar da Transparência</a> › Painel 1</p><h1>Painel 1 · Visão nacional</h1></div></div><main class="atcr-corpo"><div class="atcp"><style>
.elementor-widget-theme-post-content>.atcp,.elementor-widget-theme-post-content>.elementor-widget-container>.atcp,.atcp{max-width:100%!important}
.atcp{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#2B3035}
.atcp *{box-sizing:border-box}
.atcp a{color:#1F524F}
.atcp-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:3px;margin:0 0 22px;padding:0;list-style:none;border-bottom:2px solid #1F524F;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:thin}
.atcp-nav li{flex:1 1 auto;margin:0;padding:0}
.atcp-nav li::before{display:none}
.atcp-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;white-space:nowrap;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid #CFE0DD;border-bottom:0;border-radius:9px 9px 0 0;background:#F2F7F6;color:#1F524F!important;text-decoration:none!important;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;min-height:40px}
.atcp-nav a i{font-style:normal;display:inline-flex;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;background:#fff;color:#1F524F}
.atcp-nav a:hover{background:#E3EFED}
.atcp-nav a[aria-current]{background:#1F524F;border-color:#1F524F;color:#fff!important}
.atcp-nav a[aria-current] i{background:#2F7E79;color:#fff}
.atcp-intro{max-width:68ch;margin:0 0 18px;font-size:16px}
.atcp-barra{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0 0 14px}
.atcp-barra>span{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#4A5A60;margin-right:4px}
.atcp-barra button,.atcp-btn{font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;padding:8px 14px;min-height:40px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #CFE0DD;background:#fff;color:#1F524F!important;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none!important;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.atcp-barra button[aria-pressed=true],.atcp-btn.forte{background:#1F524F;border-color:#1F524F;color:#fff!important}
.atcp-filtros{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 14px;align-items:flex-end;margin:0 0 20px;padding:14px;background:#F2F7F6;border-radius:12px}
.atcp-filtros label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#4A5A60;flex:1 1 160px;min-width:0}
.atcp-filtros label.largo{flex:2 1 260px}
.atcp-filtros label.marca{flex:0 0 auto;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px}
.atcp-filtros label.marca input{width:auto;min-height:0}
.atcp-filtros select,.atcp-filtros input{font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:400;padding:8px 10px;min-height:40px;border:1px solid #CFE0DD;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#2B3035;width:100%}
.atcp-filtros select:disabled{background:#EEF2F2;color:#6B7578}
.atcp-filtros .atcp-btn{flex:0 0 auto}
.atcp-filtros.atcp-grade{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px 14px;align-items:end}
.atcp-grade>label,.atcp-grade>.faixa{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#4A5A60}
.atcp-grade>.dois{grid-column:span 2}
.atcp-grade .faixa>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.atcp-grade select,.atcp-grade input{height:40px}
.atcp-grade .rodape{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #DCE8E6}
@media(max-width:1100px){.atcp-filtros.atcp-grade{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:820px){.atcp-filtros.atcp-grade{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:520px){.atcp-filtros.atcp-grade{gap:10px}.atcp-grade .faixa{grid-column:span 2}}
@media(max-width:340px){.atcp-filtros.atcp-grade{grid-template-columns:1fr}.atcp-grade>.dois,.atcp-grade .faixa{grid-column:auto}}
.atcp-evid{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #2F7E79;background:#2F7E79;color:#fff!important;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;margin-left:6px}
.atcp-evid:hover,.atcp-evid:focus{background:#1F524F;border-color:#1F524F}
.atcp-resumo{font-size:14px;color:#4A5A60;margin:-8px 0 18px}
.atcp-resumo b{color:#122F2D}
.atcp-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:14px;margin:0 0 24px}
.atcp-kpis>div{background:#F2F7F6;border-radius:10px;padding:16px}
.atcp-kpis b{display:block;font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;font-size:30px;line-height:1.1;color:#122F2D}
.atcp-kpis span{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#4A5A60;margin-top:4px}
.atcp-kpis em{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-top:6px;color:#2A6F6A}
.atcp-kpis em.neg{color:#9A3B1F}
.atcp-kpis em a{color:#1F524F}
.atcp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px}
.atcp-card{margin:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #DCE8E6;border-radius:12px;padding:20px;min-width:0;break-inside:avoid}
.atcp-card.largo{grid-column:1/-1}
.atcp-card header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;margin:0 0 12px}
.atcp-card h2,.atcp-card h3{font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;font-size:17px;line-height:1.3;margin:0;color:#122F2D;font-style:normal}
.atcp-sub{font-size:13px;color:#4A5A60;margin:4px 0 0}
.atcp-dica{font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;color:#1F524F;font-weight:600;margin:16px 0 0;padding:9px 12px;background:#F2F7F6;border-left:3px solid #2F7E79;border-radius:0 6px 6px 0}
.atcp-acoes{margin-top:12px;padding:12px;background:#F2F7F6;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px}
.atcp-acoes b{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;color:#122F2D}
.atcp-acoes div{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.atcp-acoes .atcp-btn{font-size:13px;min-height:36px;padding:6px 10px}
.atcp-csv{flex:0 0 auto;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:6px 10px;min-height:32px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #CFE0DD;background:#fff;color:#1F524F;cursor:pointer}
.atcp-tela{position:relative;width:100%}
.atcp-rolavel{overflow-x:auto}
.atcp-tab td.atcp-cel{text-align:center;padding:6px 2px;min-width:30px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;border-bottom:1px solid #fff}
.atcp-tab th.atcp-vert{text-align:center;min-width:30px;font-size:11px;padding:6px 2px}
.atcp-tab td.num{text-align:right;width:62px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#p8-tab{min-width:1000px;table-layout:fixed}
#p8-tab th:first-child,#p8-tab td:first-child{width:300px}
#p8-tab th:nth-child(2),#p8-tab td:nth-child(2){width:58px}
#p8-tab td:first-child{white-space:normal;word-break:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:1.3}
#p8-tab td:first-child a{text-decoration:none}
.atcp-dimleg{list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:2px 14px;margin:14px 0 0;padding:0;font-size:12px;color:#2B3035}
.atcp-dimleg li{padding:2px 0}
.atcp-dimleg b{display:inline-block;min-width:20px;color:#1F524F}
.atcp-escala{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-top:14px;font-size:12px}
.atcp-escala span{color:#4A5A60}
.atcp-escala i{font-style:normal;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:4px}
#p8-tab tbody tr:hover td:first-child{text-decoration:underline}
.atcp-heat{border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;width:100%;display:table!important}
.atcp-heat th{font-weight:600;color:#4A5A60;padding:4px 6px;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap}
.atcp-heat thead th{text-align:center}
.atcp-heat td{text-align:center;padding:6px 4px;min-width:38px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;border:1px solid #fff}
.atcp-heat td[data-go],.atcp-heat td[data-a]{cursor:pointer}
.atcp-heat td[data-go]:hover,.atcp-heat td[data-a]:hover{outline:2px solid #122F2D;outline-offset:-2px}
.atcp-heat .sel{outline:2px solid #B8913A;outline-offset:-2px}
.atcp-mapawrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 240px;gap:16px;align-items:start}
.atcp-mapa{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.atcp-mapa path{stroke:#fff;stroke-width:.8;cursor:pointer}
.atcp-mapa path:hover,.atcp-mapa path:focus,.atcp-mapa path.ativo{stroke:#122F2D;stroke-width:2;outline:none}
.atcp-info{background:#F2F7F6;border-radius:10px;padding:14px;font-size:14px;min-height:150px}
.atcp-info b{display:block;font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;font-size:18px;color:#122F2D}
.atcp-info .atcp-btn{margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;min-height:36px;padding:6px 10px}
.atcp-legenda{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;color:#4A5A60;margin-top:10px}
.atcp-legenda i{flex:1;height:10px;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#E6F1EF,#72C3C6,#2F7E79,#122F2D)}
.atcp-legenda.niv{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.atcp-legenda.niv span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.atcp-legenda.niv em{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block}
.atcp-mapanav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.atcp-mapanav span{font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;font-weight:700;color:#122F2D;font-size:16px}
.atcp-mapamun{width:100%;height:auto;max-height:72vh;display:block}
.atcp-mapamun path{stroke:#fff;stroke-width:.5;cursor:pointer}
.atcp-mapamun path:hover,.atcp-mapamun path:focus,.atcp-mapamun path.ativo{stroke:#122F2D;stroke-width:1.6;outline:none}
.atcp-cor{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-top:12px;font-size:13px}
.atcp-cor label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;color:#4A5A60}
.atcp-cor select{min-height:36px;border:1px solid #C9DCD9;border-radius:8px;padding:4px 8px;font:inherit;color:#122F2D;background:#fff}
.atcp-info ol{margin:8px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.atcp-info li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:4px 0;border-top:1px solid #DCE8E6;font-size:13px}
.atcp-info li i{font-style:normal;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.atcp-info .nv{display:inline-block;border-radius:4px;padding:0 5px;font-size:11px;margin-left:4px}
.atcp-tab{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;display:table!important;table-layout:fixed}
.atcp-tab th{text-align:left;color:#4A5A60;font-weight:600;border-bottom:1px solid #DCE8E6;padding:6px 4px}
.atcp-tab td{padding:8px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF4F3;vertical-align:top;word-wrap:break-word}
.atcp-tab tr[data-go]{cursor:pointer}
.atcp-tab tr[data-go]:hover td{background:#F2F7F6}
.atcp-tab tr.sel td{background:#FBF5E6}
.atcp-tab td.n{width:96px}
.atcp-tab small{color:#4A5A60}
.atcp-barrinha{position:relative;background:#EEF4F3;border-radius:4px;height:20px}
.atcp-barrinha i{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;background:#72C3C6;border-radius:4px}
.atcp-barrinha span{position:relative;padding-left:6px;line-height:20px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px}
.atcp-pag{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-top:14px;font-size:13px}
.atcp-pag button{font:inherit;font-size:13px;min-width:40px;min-height:40px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #CFE0DD;background:#fff;color:#1F524F;cursor:pointer}
.atcp-pag button[aria-current]{background:#1F524F;color:#fff;border-color:#1F524F}
.atcp-pag button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}
.atcp-nivel{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:999px;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap}
.atcp-sit{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap}
.atcp-sit.s{background:#2F7E79;color:#fff}.atcp-sit.n{background:#F3D9CC;color:#7A2E12}
.atcp-it{display:inline-flex;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:5px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;margin:0 3px 3px 0}
.atcp-it.s{background:#1D7A44;color:#fff}.atcp-it.n{background:#B3261E;color:#fff}.atcp-it.x{background:#E9EDEE;color:#5F6B6E}
.atcp-leg{display:inline-flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:2px 6px;margin-left:4px}.atcp-leg .atcp-it{margin:0}
.atcp-kpis span.ess{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#2A6F6A;margin-top:2px}.atcp-kpis span.ess.baixo{color:#A3271B}
.atcp-rolar{overflow-x:auto}
.atcp-fases{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px;min-width:620px}
.atcp-fases th,.atcp-fases td{padding:10px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF4F3;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}
.atcp-fases thead th{font-size:12px;color:#4A5A60;font-weight:700;border-bottom:2px solid #DCE8E6}
.atcp-fases tbody th{font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;font-size:15px;color:#122F2D}
.atcp-fases td b{font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;font-size:17px;color:#122F2D;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.atcp-fases td i{font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;margin-left:6px}.atcp-fases i.cai{color:#A3271B}.atcp-fases i.sobe{color:#1D7A44}
.atcp-fases td small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#2A6F6A;font-weight:600;margin-top:2px}.atcp-fases td small.baixo{color:#A3271B}
.atcp-fases td.sem{color:#5F6B6E;font-size:13px}.atcp-fases td.fin{background:#F2F7F6}.atcp-fases td.fin .atcp-nivel{display:inline-block;margin-top:6px}
.atcp-dimcab{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px 12px;align-items:center;margin:22px 0 6px;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:2px solid #DCE8E6}
.atcp-dimcab h3{font-size:15px}
.atcp-dimcab span{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#2A6F6A}
.atcp-dimcab a{font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.atcp-crit{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:6px 14px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF4F3;font-size:14px}
.atcp-crit small{display:block;color:#4A5A60;font-size:12px;margin-top:3px}
.atcp-crit .div{color:#9A3B1F;font-weight:600}
.atcp-cab-ficha{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin:0 0 18px}
.atcp-cab-ficha h2{font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;font-size:24px;margin:0;color:#122F2D}
.atcp-cab-ficha p{margin:6px 0 0;color:#4A5A60}
.atcp-carregando{padding:30px;text-align:center;color:#4A5A60}
.atcp-nota{font-size:13px;color:#4A5A60;margin:24px 0 0;max-width:80ch}
.atcp-volta{margin-top:28px;font-size:14px}
.atcp-tip{position:fixed;z-index:99999;max-width:300px;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:8px;background:#122F2D;color:#fff;font:600 12.5px/1.4 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.atcp-tip[hidden]{display:none}
.atcp-lista{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.atcp-lista li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:6px 16px;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px;margin:0 0 8px;border:1px solid #DCE8E6;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer}
.atcp-lista li::before{display:none}
.atcp-lista li:hover,.atcp-lista li:focus{border-color:#2F7E79;background:#F8FBFA;outline:none}
.atcp-lista .nome a{font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:#122F2D!important;text-decoration:none!important}
.atcp-lista .nome small{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:#4A5A60;margin-top:2px}
.atcp-lista .hist{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 10px;margin-top:6px;font-size:12px;color:#4A5A60}
.atcp-lista .hist b{color:#122F2D;font-weight:700}
.atcp-lista .extra{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:6px}
.atcp-lista .extra span{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:6px;background:#EEF4F3;color:#1F524F}
.atcp-lista .nota{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;justify-content:flex-end}
.atcp-lista .nota b{font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;font-size:22px;color:#122F2D;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.atcp-lista .nota b small{font-size:13px;color:#4A5A60;margin-left:1px}
.atcp-lista .nota .ind{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;line-height:1.15}
.atcp-lista .nota .ess{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#2A6F6A;white-space:nowrap}
.atcp-lista .nota .ess.baixo{color:#A3271B}
.atcp-lista .nota .atcp-nivel{min-width:96px;text-align:center;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:6px}
.atcp-lista-cab{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 10px;font-size:14px;color:#4A5A60}
.atcp-secao{font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;font-size:20px;color:#122F2D;margin:34px 0 6px}
.atcp-secao+p{margin:0 0 16px;color:#4A5A60;font-size:14px;max-width:80ch}

					<script>
				const registerAllyAction = () => {
					if ( ! window?.ElementorProFrontendConfig || ! window?.elementorFrontend?.utils?.urlActions ) {
						return;
					}

					elementorFrontend.utils.urlActions.addAction( 'allyWidget:open', () => {
						if (window?.ea11yWidget?.widget?.open) {
							return window.ea11yWidget.widget.isOpen()
								? window.ea11yWidget.widget.close()
								: window.ea11yWidget.widget.open();
						}
					} );
				};

				const waitingLimit = 30;
				let retryCounter = 0;

				const waitForElementorPro = () => {
					return new Promise( ( resolve ) => {
						const intervalId = setInterval( () => {
							if ( retryCounter === waitingLimit ) {
								resolve( null );
							}

							retryCounter++;

							if ( window.elementorFrontend && window?.elementorFrontend?.utils?.urlActions ) {
								clearInterval( intervalId );
								resolve( window.elementorFrontend );
							}
								}, 100 ); // Check every 100 milliseconds for availability of elementorFrontend
					});
				};

				waitForElementorPro().then( () => { registerAllyAction(); });
			</script>

				( () => {
					const lazyloadRunObserver = () => {
						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
									}
									lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
								}
							});
						}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
							lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',
					];
					events.forEach( ( event ) => {
						document.addEventListener( event, lazyloadRunObserver );
					} );
				} )();
			</script>
